title: Lemaitre damage variable + evolution equation
objective: Add the Lemaitre continuum damage model: scalar damage variable D in [0, 1), evolution law dD/dp = (Y / S_d)^s_d with Y = energy release rate and (S_d, s_d) material parameters.
scope: Add `mechdsl.symbolic.models.lemaitre` with the damage state variable and evolution equation.
Implement the effective stress principle: sigma_eff = sigma / (1 - D).
Expose as `material_type='lemaitre'` (building on J2 power-law — the damage model needs a plastic driver).
State variables: alpha (equivalent plastic strain) + D (damage).
Parameters: (E, nu, sigma_y0, K, n, S_d, s_d, eps_D) where eps_D is the damage threshold.
implementation_steps: Implement the effective-stress return mapping: run J2 return map on effective stress, then update D via the evolution law.
Energy release rate Y = sigma_eq^2 R_v / (2 E (1-D)^2) where R_v is the triaxiality factor.
Unit-test monotonic damage growth under monotonic plastic loading.
Unit-test the damage threshold eps_D: no damage until alpha > eps_D.
acceptance_criteria: D is monotonically non-decreasing under monotonic plastic loading.
D stays at 0 until alpha > eps_D.
At D = 0, the model produces identical stress to J2 power-law (regression).

cases: D approaches D_crit and stays below 1

risks: The (1 - D) divisor in the effective stress is numerically fragile as D -> 1. Mitigation: clamp D < 1 - 1e-6 and mark the element for deletion (handled in P6-2).
completion_notes: Added LemaitreMaterial + LemaitreReturnResult frozen dataclasses with 8-parameter validation.
Effective-stress principle via strain-equivalence: J2 radial_return on undamaged elastic predictor yields sigma_eff; nominal stress = (1-D_new)*sigma_eff.
Energy release rate Y = sigma_eq^2 R_v / (2 E (1-D)^2); triaxiality R_v = 2/3 (1+nu) + 3 (1-2nu) (sigma_H/sigma_eq)^2 with sigma_eq=0 guard.
D clamp at 1 - 1e-6; threshold gate alpha_new > eps_D.
D=0 regression verified byte-identical to J2 power-law across 3 strain states (max_diff < 1e-12).
11 tests (4 acceptance + 7 failure-route: hydrostatic, below-yield, triaxiality edges, Y=0 at sigma_eq=0, D-clamp, material validation, nominal-stress scaling).
Scope held to lemaitre.py + test file only — no frontend/IR/codegen wiring (P6-2 scope).

Forward-warning to P6-2: tangent returned is undamaged J2 algorithmic tangent; Newton convergence under active damage may degrade. Either carry tangent_is_consistent=False or derive C_alg^damaged = (1-D) C_alg^J2 - (dD/de) ⊗ sigma_eff.
Fast suite: 1211 passed / 6 skipped / 1 failed (pre-existing P6T5 TODO-guard flagging P6-2/P6-3 stub imports; clears when those land).
